scope: All 62 post-T10 parity milestones; staffing and sequencing only
user_direction: Prioritize total execution time; start all24 T11 milestone authors if work can be safely separated; additional agents permitted when useful.

execution_capacity.runtime_requirement: Two independent execution chats or a larger verified runtime pool; the current single-root pool has16 direct-worker slots.

browser_workflow.duties: Browser/workflow coordination and final shared-branch integration.

operators.duties: Operator/recovery coordination and reviewed change handoff.

assumptions.author_minutes: Existing single-lead implementation and focused-verification estimate
assumptions.individual_demos: Outside timed implementation model; show due work during three-hour breaks and at turn end
assumptions.corrections: Re-estimate after findings; zero in deterministic baseline
assumptions.human_wait: Excluded and never treated as acceptance
assumptions.worktree_isolation: Independent feature changes with primary-controlled shared-file integration
assumptions.final_turn_gate_scope: Combine independently reviewed domain results and run full checks; behavioral edits during final consolidation require fresh affected-scope review and measured extra time.
assumptions.shared_seams: Actual overlap is serialized only at the affected function or contract; time beyond the allowance extends the forecast.
assumptions.integration_review_order: Author completes -> domain combines the change -> fresh milestone reviewer assesses complete combined change at pinned commit -> primary combines reviewed domains and runs final gate.

Workspace.coord: Navigation, subscriptions, sidebar and saved view state.

Card UI.coord: Card face, drawer, filtering, formatting and guarded pending edits.

Files.coord: Upload selection, operation identity, replay checks and job-scoped state.

Workflow.coord: Lane configuration, grants, approval audit and presentation.

Bot CLI.coord: Dispatch, ticket resolution, offline reads and shared report projection.

Activity.coord: Historical identity, coverage, routing and committed operation metadata.

Recovery.coord: Durable admission, retained recovery authority and restore.

Publication.coord: Capture inventory, remote/ref selection, index and process cleanup.

Operations.coord: Detached launch, replacement and workload measurement.
